_about: James Bonar (1852-1941), Scottish economist and historian of economic thought. Not Andrew or Horatius Bonar (shelves andrew-bonar, horatius-bonar). Raw IA OCR: Parson Malthus (Glasgow: James Maclehose, 1881), Malthus and His Work (London: Macmillan, 1885), Philosophy and Political Economy in some of their historical relations (London: Swan Sonnenschein, 1893; the OCR reads the year 'i«93'), The Intellectual Virtues, a lecture of 1893 (London: Macmillan, 1894), Elements of Political Economy (London: John Murray, 1903) and Disturbing Elements in the Study and Teaching of Political Economy (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins, 1911). Not taken: The Moral Sense (1930), and his editions of Ricardo's letters and Adam Smith's library catalogue, which are mostly other men's words. US public domain. No uids minted.
